purpose: Teach: 表象/場内/別館/採集/持ち出す/取り返し/備考/呼びかける

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の表象、本気で、絶対、市民の安全、第一に、絶対、努めてまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: The police department's commitment is, in all seriousness, to put citizen safety first. We're genuinely grateful for the opportunity to serve.
lines.style: Measured, formal opening. Steady breath. Each commitment lands with quiet weight. Professional composure maintained throughout, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、警察の発表、場内、絶対、注目しております、本気で、本気、絶対、本当に、感謝、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. We've been paying very close attention to the police department's announcements. We're truly grateful for your leadership and guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Nods subtly mid-sentence. Even pace, clear diction. The tone of someone listening intently and meaning every word of thanks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察署の別館、本気で、絶対、市民、絶対、お越し、いただける空間、整えております、本気で、本気、絶対、本当に、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: We've prepared the station annex to be a welcoming, accessible space for community members who need to visit us. Please feel assured of that.
lines.style: Procedural but human. Speaks to competence first, then reassurance. Steady cadence. Slight warmth on 'welcoming' — this is a place that's been thought through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者からの情報、本気で、絶対、慎重に、絶対、採集、進めております、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. We're handling all victim information with careful attention. Every detail is being collected and processed thoughtfully.
lines.style: Serious, focused. Slower tempo on 'careful attention' — shows this is non-negotiable. Quiet confidence underneath. The tone of someone who knows the weight of this work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠品、本気で、絶対、警察、外に、絶対、持ち出すこと、ありません、本気で、本気、絶対、ご安心、本気で、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Evidence will never leave the station. You have my word on that. We take the integrity of the investigation as our core responsibility.
lines.style: Firm declaration on 'never leave.' Pause after 'word.' Then solid, unhurried. The certainty of someone making a promise they intend to keep.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取り返しのつかない、本気で、絶対、犯罪、絶対、防ぐ、当社の、本気で、絶対、責任、本気で、感謝、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to preventing crimes before they happen. That's not just policy—it's our responsibility to you and to this community.
lines.style: Conviction on 'committed.' Slight emphasis on 'responsibility.' Warm but serious. The register of someone speaking to shared purpose, not just procedure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害届の備考欄、本気で、絶対、市民、絶対、丁寧に、お書きください、本気で、感謝、しております
lines.en: When you file your report, please describe everything in the remarks section as clearly and completely as you can. Take your time.
lines.style: Clear, instructional. Gentle on 'take your time'—permission and reassurance mixed. Professional but accessible. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に、本気で、絶対、防犯活動、呼びかけることを、続けてまいります、本気で、本気、絶対、警察様、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'll continue urging our staff to stay vigilant and engaged in crime prevention. Thank you for working with us on this.
lines.style: Warm close. Quieter than opening. Genuine gratitude underneath the formality. Slight softening on the final phrase—partnership, not just procedure.
